notes:
### Added
- **Editable copies.** Each bucket in the card sheet can be re-labelled
  (condition / printing / slab grade) in place, keeping its quantity.
- **Slab details.** The Graded bucket records company, grade and an optional
  cert number (e.g. "PSA 9.5").
- **Wishlist ("Wanted").** A star toggle in the card sheet, a Wanted search
  filter, and wishlist round-trip in backups (new `wishlist` table, Dexie v11).
- **Collection dashboard (Sets tab).** Cards owned, sets complete, and the
  estimated collection value (summed from cached Near-Mint prices, flagged when
  partial).
- **Browse your collection from Search.** Filter chips — All, Owned, Missing,
  Duplicates, Wanted — a Sort control (Name / Set / Recently updated), and an
  honest "N results · showing first 200" line.
- **Set breakdown + bulk edit.** Copies per condition and owned/total per rarity,
  a **Dupes** tab, and a Select mode with a bulk bar (add a copy in a chosen
  condition, or remove).

### Changed
- **Set detail sorting.** Sort a set by Number, Rarity, or Value.
- **Search is debounced** (~150 ms) so typing stays smooth over the full catalog.
- **Bundle is code-split.** The card snapshots, vendor libs and the Scan/Settings
  views are their own chunks (entry JS ~183 kB instead of ~6.8 MB), and those
  two views load on demand.
- **Accessibility.** Modals trap focus, restore it on close and close on Escape;
  async status messages are live regions; small controls have larger hit targets.
- **Backups are v3** and include the wishlist; import still accepts the older
  flat and `variants` shapes.
- **Settings → Collection Stats.** Dropped the "card data is built in" note and
  kept the completed-sets tally ("N of M sets completed").

### Notes
- No scan-index rebuild required: the descriptor, `SCAN_VERSION`, `DATA_VERSION`
  and card data are untouched.
